newsitem.title: USA: EXEL has 90 pct of GCR shrs.
newsitem.headline: EXEL has 90 pct of GCR shrs.

text.p: EXEL Ltd said Thursday it has accepted the 23,071,143 GCR Holdings Ltd shares tendered in response to its offer, resulting in EXEL owning in excess of 90 percent of those outstanding.
EXEL's cash offer for all of GCR's outstanding ordinary shares expired, as scheduled, on Wednesday, the company said.

In the next step of the acquisition, pursuant to a compulsory acquisition of shares under Cayman Islands law, Exel said, it intends to give notice it intends to acquire compulsorily such shares at $27.00 per share in cash.

In addition, pursuant to the merger agreement, members of GCR's board of directors, other than two outside directors, have tendered their resignations and are being replaced by designees of EXEL. Further, the ordinary shares of GCR will be deregistered under the United States securities laws and delisted from the Nasdaq National Market as soon as practicable. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
